opportunities.name_zh: 出雲大社・松之參道與拝殿社殿
opportunities.best_time: 06:00–19:00 參拜開放時間內的白天可見光（景點當地時間／JST）

condition_variants.variant_name: 松之參道與拝殿外觀的公開參拜動線
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"松の参道—拝殿 public approach Camera Zone","subject":"pine-lined approach and exterior shrine architecture"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 06:00–19:00 境內參拜時間內；僅限開放動線；不得越過八足門或妨礙祭儀與參拜；超出私人鑑賞的拍攝須先取得神社許可
condition_variants.required_conditions: 松之參道或拝殿外觀清楚可見；白天可見光；無足以妨礙步行與拍攝的強降水
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和日光與樹蔭層次；較少人流時較容易構圖，並非目前預報可驗證的條件
condition_variants.penalties: 強降水；境內關閉；祭事／人流造成動線限制；未經許可進行公開或業務攝影

viewpoints.note: The official precinct guide identifies the pine approach and Haiden as a visitor route. This geotagged point is a medium-confidence area reference near that route, not a mandatory tripod location, main-sanctuary entrance or road-navigation target.
viewpoints.name: 出雲大社・松之參道至拝殿公開步行區 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 沿官方公開參拜動線移動構圖；本殿及八足門內部不是公開拍攝區。此座標僅為大致 Camera Zone 錨點。

spot.access_hours_source: Izumo Oyashiro official 2026-05-03 visiting-hours notice; checked 2026-09-25

access_note_i18n.zh-TW: 境內一般參拜 06:00–19:00；其他時段僅能在銅鳥居前參拜。私人紀念攝影應避免妨礙參拜；超出私人鑑賞的公開／商業拍攝須事先向神社申請。
access_note_i18n.en: General precinct visiting hours are 06:00–19:00; outside those hours worship is from before the bronze torii. Personal photography should respect worshippers; public or commercial filming beyond personal use requires prior shrine permission.
access_note_i18n.ja: 境内の通常参拝時間は06:00～19:00。時間外は銅鳥居前からの参拝です。個人撮影は参拝者に配慮し、個人鑑賞の範囲を超える公開・業務撮影は事前許可が必要です。

label_i18n.zh-TW: 出雲大社：參道入口或停車場須擇一
label_i18n.en: Izumo Taisha: choose approach entrance or parking
label_i18n.ja: 出雲大社：参道入口・駐車場を選択

navigation_target.source: Izumo Oyashiro official approach map and Izumo Tourism Association parking/access guide; reviewed 2026-09-25

note_i18n.zh-TW: 徒步自勢溜參道進入，開車可用大停車場等不同入口；本殿區座標不能作為道路導航目的地，待支援路線選擇後再提供導航。
note_i18n.en: The Seidamari walking approach and shrine parking areas are distinct arrivals. The main-sanctuary coordinate is not a road destination; route selection is needed before offering directions.
note_i18n.ja: 勢溜からの徒歩参道と大駐車場などの車での到着地点は異なります。本殿付近の座標を道路案内の目的地にせず、経路選択実装後にナビを提供します。
